title: AI-143 decision adapter input envelope
description: Common adapter protocol ai-lab-decision-adapter 1.0.0, framing json-line-v1: exactly one input envelope written once to the adapter's stdin as one compact UTF-8 JSON line, then EOF. Provider-neutral and candidate-neutral. request is the exact AI-140 typed decision request and request_hash its AI-140 request hash; the hash binding is enforced by src/decision-sandbox/validation.ts. Carries no executable, argument, environment, network, credential or authority field.
